notes: Official PostgreSQL documentation is the primary technical reference. PostgreSQL 18.6 is the primary version scope. PostgreSQL 19 beta/development material is not treated as stable. The syllabus is mapped across the full course, but each lesson still requires technical review and sample-query testing before publication; service/provider connection details can vary by environment.

references.title: PostgreSQL 18.6 documentation
supports: Overall official PostgreSQL 18.6 manual, SQL, administration, client tools, server programming and internals.

references.title: PostgreSQL 18 release notes
supports: Version-dependent PostgreSQL 18 features and migration cautions, including asynchronous I/O, UUIDv7, virtual generated columns, OAuth, RETURNING OLD/NEW and temporal constraints.

references.title: PostgreSQL tutorial
supports: Foundations, creating tables, loading data, querying, joins, aggregates, updates, views, keys and transactions.

references.title: SQL language
supports: SQL statement syntax and the command reference.

references.title: Data types
supports: Built-in and specialized types, temporal types, JSON and arrays.

references.title: Data definition
supports: Tables, constraints, inheritance, partitioning, generated columns and row security.

references.title: Queries
supports: Table expressions, joins, grouping, window functions, CTEs and set operations.

references.title: Functions and operators
supports: Built-in function/operator families and type-specific behavior.

references.title: Indexes
supports: Index concepts, index methods and index design.

references.title: Using EXPLAIN
supports: Query plan interpretation and actual execution measurements.

references.title: Concurrency control
supports: Transactions, snapshots, isolation, row locks and concurrent updates.

references.title: PL/pgSQL
supports: Variables, control flow, functions, procedures and exception handling.

references.title: Triggers
supports: Trigger definitions and behavior.

references.title: Client authentication
supports: Client authentication, connection security and role-based access.

references.title: Row security policies
supports: Row-level security and role-sensitive policy behavior.

references.title: Routine database maintenance
supports: Vacuum, analyze, reindexing and maintenance tasks.

references.title: Monitoring database activity
supports: Server statistics, monitoring views and progress reporting.

references.title: Backup and restore
supports: Logical/physical backups, WAL archives and recovery planning.

references.title: High availability, load balancing and replication
supports: Replication, standby servers, failover and high-availability considerations.

references.title: Logical replication
supports: Publication/subscription behavior and logical replication.

references.title: Full-text search
supports: Tokenization, tsvector/tsquery, text configurations and ranking.

references.title: Extensions
supports: Extension interfaces, packaging, custom routines and extension management.

references.title: Foreign data wrappers
supports: Foreign data wrapper architecture and server interfaces.

references.title: PostgreSQL internals
supports: Storage, planner, WAL, backend/frontend and extension internals.

references.title: Regression tests
supports: PostgreSQL regression testing and test-suite concepts.

references.title: Psycopg 3 documentation
supports: Python PostgreSQL driver API, bound parameters, transactions and connections.
